summary: This Form 8-K reports the entry into underwriting and certificate purchase agreements for a commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) issuance by BMO 2026-5C15 Mortgage Trust. The public certificates have an aggregate principal amount of $553,359,000 and private certificates of approximately $72,790,447. The transaction is a routine securitization, not a special situation. The filing details the underwriting agreement with multiple underwriters and the exempt private placement. This is a standard capital markets transaction with no event that qualifies as a special situation under the defined categories.
